label: promotes ideology of
definition: Person or group X explicitly champions or promotes the ideology attributed to Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit championing or promoting the ideology of named Y; historical ideological advocacy. Excludes: membership, leadership or employment alone; generic support of Y without ideology advocacy; ordinary communication or opposition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear advocate or ideology source attachment; missing ideology object when advocacy cannot be resolved. This narrow ideological-advocacy relation does not imply membership in or generic support for the organization whose ideology is promoted.
